# Official label mapping fixture

`scp_statements.csv` is the unmodified small mapping file downloaded from
https://physionet.org/files/ptb-xl/1.0.3/scp_statements.csv on 2026-10-26.
It contains 71 statements, 44 diagnostic statement rows and **23 distinct
diagnostic_subclass values**. No waveform or patient metadata is included.

Source dataset: Wagner et al., PTB-XL v1.0.3, DOI 10.13026/kfzx-aw45.
Dataset license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://physionet.org/content/ptb-xl/1.0.3/ (see license and citation).
